idea-plugin.name: Chronicle Services Diagram
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a Diagram tab to Chronicle Services services.yaml files, next to the usual Text tab. It shows the YAML beside a diagram of the services and the queues they read and write.

  • Rename a queue in the diagram and every reference to it in the YAML is updated
  • Edit the YAML beside the diagram; the diagram follows as you type
  • Queues drawn as labelled arrows showing their roll cycle and master, top to bottom or left to right
  • Search, with every match highlighted
  • Right-click a node to show only its upstream and downstream, or only its direct connections
  • Click a node to find its declaration in the YAML
